```{r, source}
getTraits<-function(Class        ="predictive", 
                    Order        ="predictive", 
                    Family       ="predictive", 
                    Genus        ="predictive", 
                    Species      ="predictive",
                    partial_match=!TRUE,
                    add_ancestors=!TRUE, 
                    Database     =FishLife::FishBase_and_RAM, 
                    ParentChild_gz=Database$ParentChild_gz ){

  taxa=suppressMessages(Search_species(Class,Order,Family,Genus,Species,add_ancestors,Database,ParentChild_gz)$match_taxonomy)
  
  if(partial_match==TRUE)  Which=grep( taxa, ParentChild_gz[,'ChildName'])
  if(partial_match==FALSE) Which=which(taxa==ParentChild_gz[,'ChildName'])
  if( length(Which)!=1 ) stop( paste0("'Taxon' ",taxa," input matches more or less than one element") )
  
  Cov_gjj       =Database$Cov_gvv
  Mean_gj       =Database$beta_gv
  ParentChild_gz=Database$ParentChild_gz
  Y_ij          =Database$Y_ij
  g_i           =Database$g_i
  
  nms      =c("linf","k","winf","amax","amat","m","l50","temperature","lnvar","rho",
              "lnmasps","lnmargsd","s","logits","fmsym","fmsy","lnr","r","lhg","g")
  mu       =Mean_gj[Which,]
  names(mu)=nms
  mu       =FLPar(mu)
  
  cov      =Cov_gjj[Which,,]
  cov      =as(array(cov,c(dim(cov),1),dimnames=list(params=nms,params=nms,iter=1)),"FLPar")
  
  FLPars(mu=mu,cov=cov)}


shapeFn<-function(r,fmsy){
  m=r/fmsy
  shape=m^-(1/(m-1))
  shape}
```

```{r, data}
df= c("Shovel head",                "Glaucostegus typus",
      "Blue shark" ,                "Prionace glauca",	
      "Oceanic whitetip shark" ,    "Carcharhinus longimanus",	 	
      "Scalloped hammerhead shark" ,"Sphyrna lewini",	
      "Shortfin mako shark" ,       "Isurus oxyrinchus",
      "Silky shark",                "Carcharhinus falciformis",
      "Bigeye thresher shark" ,     "Alopias superciliosus",	 	
      "Pelagic thresher shark" ,    "Alopias pelagicus", 	
      "Porbeagle shark" ,           "Lamna nasus")

spp=data.frame(spp =df[seq(2,18,2)],
               name=df[seq(1,18,2)])
spp=transform(spp,Genus  =substr(spp,1,regexpr(" ", spp)-1),
                  Species=substr(spp,  regexpr(" ", spp)+1,nchar(spp)))

save(spp,file="../data/spp.RData")
```

```{r, lh}
lhs=mdply(spp[,c("Genus","Species")], function(Genus,Species) { 
  
  
  if (Species=="spp.")   
      rtn=suppressMessages(try(getTraits(Genus=Genus)))
  else     
      rtn=tryCatch(suppressMessages(getTraits(Genus=Genus,Species=Species)))
  
  if ("try-error"%in%is(rtn)) return(NULL) else return(t(rtn[[1]]))})

lhs$shape=shapeFn(lhs$r,exp(lhs$fmsy))

save(lhs,file="../data/lhs.RData")
```

# Priors

**Table `r iTab=iTab+1; iTab`** Pella-Tomlinson priors from FishBase.


```{r, lhs-tab}
# Select and order columns to display
lhs=transform(lhs,fmsy=exp(fmsy),linf=exp(linf),k=exp(k), m=exp(m), l50=exp(l50),
                    amax=exp(amax), amat=exp(amat)) %>%
  select(Genus, Species, k, linf, l50, amax, amat, m, r, fmsy, shape)

# Set number of decimal places for each column:
# (Genus, Species = character; linf, k, winf, amax, amat, m, l50, fmsy, r, shape = numeric)
# Example: 2 decimals for most, 3 for 'k', 0 for 'amax', etc.
digits_vec <- c(NA, NA, 2, 1, 1, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3)

# Create the table
lhs %>%
  kable(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = digits_vec,
    caption = "Key life history parameters for Red Sea species"
  ) %>% 
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center")
```


```{r, pts, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
colLabs=c("r","M","F[MSY]","l[50]/L[infinty]","B[MSY]/K")

lhs=transform(lhs,l50linf=l50/linf) 
ggpairs(lhs[,c("m","r","fmsy","l50linf","shape")], 
        columnLabels = colLabs,
        lower = list(
          continuous = wrap("smooth_lm",  # Remove method="lm" 
                            se = FALSE, 
                            color = "red", 
                            alpha = 0.8,
                            size = 1.0)
        ),
        diag = list(continuous = wrap("barDiag", 
                                      fill = "white",
                                      color = "black",
                                      bins = 20)),
        upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", 
                                       size = 5,     
                                       color = "black")),
        labeller = label_parsed) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),    
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom")+
  labs(title="Production function and life history parameters")

```

**Figure `r iFig=iFig+1; iFig`** Pella-Tomlinson priors from FishBase.

```{r, fig.height=10,fig.width=8}
source("C:/active/flr/SPMpriors/R/flmvn_traits.R") 
 
priors=ddply(spp,.(Genus,Species), with,
             flmvn_traits(Genus=Genus,Species=Species,Plot=FALSE)$mvnstk)

priors=transform(priors,doubling=log(2)/r)

ggplot(priors[,c("Genus","Species","M","sigR","r","doubling")])+
  geom_density(aes(M))+
  facet_grid(Genus+Species~.,scale="free")+
  scale_x_continuous(limit=c(0,0.5))+
  labs(title="Natural Mortality")
```

```{r, len-2, fig.height=8}
linf=ss$Growth_Parameters$Linf

lns=mutate(ss$lendbase,
                yr =(Yr%/%10)*10,
                dec=Yr-yr,
                Sexes=as.character(Sexes))
  
ggplot(lns)+    
  geom_histogram(aes(Bin,weight=Obs,fill=Sexes),binwidth=5,alpha=0.3,position = "identity")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=x,col=Sexes),data=data.frame(x=c(180,275),Sexes=unique(lns$Sexes)))+
  facet_grid(dec~yr)+
  xlab("")+ylab("Relative Number")+
  scale_fill_manual("Gender",  values=c("blue","red"),labels=c("Male","Female"))+
  scale_colour_manual("Gender",values=c("blue","red"),labels=c("Male","Female"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,0.35))+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title="Length Compositions: Blue Shark")
```

**Figure `r iFig=iFig+1; iFig`** Length compositions, length at 50% maturity is indicated.
